title: Cue JSON
description: Cueson 1.1.0 stable bounded four-format contract: exact source restoration, structured ASS v4+/SSA v4 native ownership, and exact historical v1.0.0 compatibility. Candidate identity does not imply a published release or public schema route.

$schema.description: Exact canonical schema identifier used by this Cue JSON instance.

schema_version.description: Cue JSON contract version targeted by this instance, independent of third-party producer versions.

format.description: Canonical format-family key for the source and matching native format data.

format_support.description: Truthful capabilities declared by the selected document; installed codec availability is a separate runtime fact and never rewrites this observation.

producer.description: Software identity that produced the instance; its version is independent from schema_version.

source.description: Authoritative source envelope containing portable asset identity, integrity metadata, and original bytes.

metadata.description: Optional descriptive document metadata whose null values mean the producer made no supported observation.

document.description: Derived document-level summary computed from the common cue model.

cues.description: Ordered timed semantic units in the format-neutral common model, with adjacent native fidelity data.

format_data.description: Document-level native data for the selected format; this preserves fidelity and does not replace source bytes.

diagnostics.description: Ordered deterministic observations about tolerated, malformed, unsupported, or lossy source information.

examples.message: A tolerated source variant was preserved.

stats.description: Derived aggregate counts and timing facts for the validated document.

nullable_string.title: Nullable string
nullable_string.description: A textual observation that is null when the value was unavailable or not observed.

non_negative_integer.title: Non-negative integer
non_negative_integer.description: An integer count, index, size, or duration that cannot be negative.

identifier.title: Document-local identifier
identifier.description: A lowercase hyphenated identifier that is unique within its documented Cue JSON scope.

format_support.title: Official format support
format_support.description: Capabilities declared by the official Cueson contract for one recognized format family.

status.description: Declared support maturity. Official native output is stable; exact current scripted inputs may retain truthful schema_only or complete experimental native observations without capability normalization.

ingest_supported.description: Whether official Cueson software can parse this format into the common and native models.

render_supported.description: Whether official Cueson software can render this format from the structured model.

restore_supported.description: Whether original source assets can be restored exactly from the source envelope.

ocr_required_for_semantic_output.description: Whether semantic cue output for this format requires derived OCR observations.

subrip_format_support.title: SubRip format support
subrip_format_support.description: Current official stable capabilities for the recognized SubRip format family.

webvtt_format_support.title: WebVTT format support
webvtt_format_support.description: Current official stable capabilities for the recognized WebVTT format family.

producer.title: Producer identity
producer.description: Identity of the software that created this Cue JSON instance.

name.description: Non-empty name of the producer software or integration.

version.description: Producer software version, which is independent from the Cue JSON schema version.

source.title: Source envelope
source.description: Authoritative ordered bundle of original source assets and their integrity metadata.

primary_asset_id.description: Document-local identifier resolving to exactly one primary asset in assets.

assets.description: Ordered source assets whose original bytes remain authoritative for exact restoration.

source_asset.title: Source asset
source_asset.description: One portable source-envelope member with original bytes, integrity facts, and observations.

id.description: Document-local asset identifier used by source and derived observation references.

role.description: Whether this asset is the bundle primary or an associated companion asset.

file_name.description: Safe original basename only, without any directory, URI, drive, host, or traversal component.

media_type.description: Observed media type for the source asset, or null when unavailable.

size.description: Exact decoded byte length plus an optional human-readable size observation.

hashes.description: Cryptographic identities calculated from the authoritative original bytes.

timestamps.description: Captured source timestamp observations and truthful creation-time provenance.

encoding.description: Text encoding observations, or null when the asset is binary or no observation is available.

data_base64.description: Authoritative original asset bytes encoded as canonical standard base64.

safe_basename.title: Portable safe basename
safe_basename.description: A source filename without path components or names unsafe on supported filesystems.

anyOf.description: Relative directory markers forbidden as source basenames.

asset_size.title: Source asset size
asset_size.description: Exact source byte length and optional display text supplied by the producer.

bytes.description: Exact number of bytes recovered after decoding data_base64.

text.description: Optional human-readable size label, or null when not supplied.

asset_hashes.title: Source asset hashes
asset_hashes.description: Cryptographic hashes calculated from the authoritative original source bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the decoded original asset bytes.

timestamps.title: Source timestamps
timestamps.description: Untrusted captured timestamp observations with explicit creation-time provenance.

created.description: Observed creation or birth instant, or null when unavailable.

modified.description: Observed modification instant, or null when unavailable.

accessed.description: Observed access instant, or null when unavailable.

created_source.description: Provenance of created, distinguishing true birth time, Windows creation time, fallback ctime, and absence.

nullable_timestamp.title: Nullable timestamp
nullable_timestamp.description: A timestamp observation, or null when that timestamp was unavailable.

timestamp.title: Timestamp observation
timestamp.description: One instant represented both as RFC 3339 text and Unix nanoseconds for exact comparison.

iso.description: RFC 3339 date-time representation of the observed instant.

unix_ns.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch for the same instant represented by iso.

encoding_observation.title: Text encoding observation
encoding_observation.description: Derived observations about byte-order marks, line endings, encoding, and confidence.

bom.description: Observed byte-order mark name, or null when no mark was present or recognized.

line_endings.description: Observed physical line-ending style in the authoritative source bytes.

detected_encoding.description: Detected or declared text encoding name, or null when unavailable.

confidence.description: Derived confidence from zero through one, or null when the detector provides no score.

metadata.title: Document metadata
metadata.description: Optional descriptive metadata observed or supplied for the subtitle document.

title.description: Human-readable document title, or null when no title is available.

language.description: Observed or declared language tag, or null when unavailable.

kind.description: Observed semantic kind such as subtitles or captions, or null when unavailable.

description.description: Human-readable document description, or null when none is available.

document_summary.title: Document summary
document_summary.description: Derived aggregate timing and cue facts calculated from the common model.

cue_count.description: Number of cues in the common model.

media_start_milliseconds.description: Earliest cue start in milliseconds, or null when no timed range is available.

media_end_milliseconds.description: Latest cue end in milliseconds, or null when no timed range is available.

media_span_milliseconds.description: Milliseconds from the earliest cue start to latest cue end, or null when unavailable.

has_word_level_timing.description: Whether any common-model token carries word-level timing.

nullable_non_negative_integer.title: Nullable non-negative integer
nullable_non_negative_integer.description: A non-negative integer observation, or null when the measurement is unavailable.

cue.title: Cue
cue.description: One ordered timed semantic unit with common-model content and adjacent native fidelity data.

id.description: Document-local cue identifier used by diagnostics and other cue references.

ordinal.description: Zero-based ordinal of this cue among semantic cues.

source_order.description: Zero-based position in the combined native cue and non-cue source sequence.

source_identifier.description: Native cue identifier or sequence text, or null when the format supplies none.

timing.description: Normalized cue timing in integer milliseconds.

payload.description: Decoded native text and its derived plain-text representation without replacing source bytes.

speakers.description: Ordered native or heuristic speaker observations derived from cue content.

tokens.description: Ordered derived text tokens with optional native timing provenance.

ocr_observations.description: Repeatable derived OCR observations that never replace native text, images, or source assets.

placement.description: Normalized placement hints, or null when no common placement was observed.

format_data.description: Cue-level native data for the selected source format.

timing.title: Normalized cue timing
timing.description: Start, end, and duration values in integer milliseconds for one cue.

start_milliseconds.description: Cue start offset in milliseconds from the media timeline origin.

end_milliseconds.description: Cue end offset in milliseconds from the media timeline origin.

duration_milliseconds.description: Cue duration in milliseconds, equal to end_milliseconds minus start_milliseconds.

payload.title: Cue text payload
payload.description: Native decoded text plus derived plain text and ordered logical lines.

raw_text.description: Decoded native textual payload retained without destructive semantic normalization.

plain_text.description: Derived readable text with supported native markup semantics removed.

lines.description: Ordered logical text lines exposed by the common model.

speaker.title: Speaker observation
speaker.description: A named speaker derived from native markup or a documented heuristic.

name.description: Non-empty speaker name as observed or inferred from cue content.

origin.description: Whether the speaker came from native format syntax or a heuristic observation.

token.title: Timed text token
token.description: A derived cue-text token with normalized timing and optional native timing syntax.

start_milliseconds.description: Token start offset in integer milliseconds.

end_milliseconds.description: Token end offset in integer milliseconds.

native_timing.description: Retained native timing syntax, or null when the token has no native timing source.

ocr_observation.title: OCR observation
ocr_observation.description: A repeatable derived recognition result with explicit engine and source provenance.

id.description: Document-local identifier for this OCR observation.

derived.description: Confirms that OCR output is derived observation data and never source truth.

engine.description: Non-empty identity of the OCR engine that produced this observation.

engine_version.description: OCR engine version, or null when the engine did not report one.

model.description: OCR model identity, or null when no model was reported.

language.description: Observed or requested OCR language, or null when unavailable.

text.description: Derived recognized text for this observation.

lines.description: Ordered lines of derived recognized text.

confidence.description: Derived recognition confidence from zero through one, or null when unavailable.

alternatives.description: Ordered alternative recognized strings reported by the OCR engine.

source_asset_id.description: Document-local identifier of the authoritative source asset observed by OCR.

source_event_id.description: Provider-specific source event identifier, or null when unavailable.

source_image_id.description: Provider-specific source image identifier, or null when unavailable.

source_regions.description: Ordered image regions from which this OCR observation was derived.

processing_options.description: Namespaced provider options used to derive the observation.

source_region.title: OCR source region
source_region.description: A non-negative rectangular image region used as OCR input.

x.description: Horizontal origin of the source region in provider-defined image units.

y.description: Vertical origin of the source region in provider-defined image units.

width.description: Strictly positive width of the source region in provider-defined image units.

height.description: Strictly positive height of the source region in provider-defined image units.

extension_map.title: Namespaced extension map
extension_map.description: Extension object whose property names use a lowercase namespace and local name separated by a colon.

placement.title: Normalized cue placement
placement.description: Common placement observations whose nullable fields mean no corresponding value was available.

line.description: Normalized line placement, or null when no line placement was observed.

position.description: Normalized horizontal position, or null when no position was observed.

size.description: Normalized cue-box size, or null when no size was observed.

align.description: Normalized cue alignment, or null when no alignment was observed.

cue_format_data.title: Cue native format data
cue_format_data.description: Exactly one cue-level native representation matching the document format.

subrip_cue_format_data.title: SubRip cue format data
subrip_cue_format_data.description: Cue native-data wrapper used when format is subrip.

subrip.description: Native SubRip fields retained for this cue.

webvtt_cue_format_data.title: WebVTT cue format data
webvtt_cue_format_data.description: Cue native-data wrapper used when format is webvtt.

webvtt.description: Native WebVTT fields retained for this cue.

subrip_cue_data.title: Native SubRip cue data
subrip_cue_data.description: Original decoded SubRip sequence and timing syntax plus optional coordinates.

sequence_line_raw.description: Decoded SubRip sequence line exactly as retained by native ingest.

timing_line_raw.description: Decoded native SubRip timing line, including retained coordinate syntax when present.

coordinates.description: Parsed SubRip coordinate extension when all four native coordinates are present.

coordinates.title: SubRip coordinates
coordinates.description: Four native integer coordinates parsed from a SubRip timing line.

webvtt_cue_data.title: Native WebVTT cue data
webvtt_cue_data.description: Retained WebVTT identifier, timing, settings, occurrences, and payload syntax for one cue.

identifier_raw.description: Decoded native WebVTT cue identifier, or null when the cue has none.

timing_line_raw.description: Decoded WebVTT timing line including all retained native settings syntax.

settings_raw.description: Decoded settings substring following the WebVTT cue timing range.

settings.description: Effective recognized WebVTT cue settings after native occurrence processing.

setting_occurrences.description: Ordered raw WebVTT cue setting occurrences, including invalid and unrecognized settings.

raw_payload.description: Decoded WebVTT cue payload joined with LF while preserving native markup.

raw_payload_lines.description: Ordered non-empty physical WebVTT payload lines without embedded line terminators.

webvtt_setting_occurrence.title: WebVTT setting occurrence
webvtt_setting_occurrence.description: One ordered raw setting occurrence with parsed name, value, recognition, and validity facts.

raw.description: Non-empty raw native setting token exactly as decoded.

name.description: Parsed setting name, which may be empty when the raw occurrence is malformed.

value.description: Parsed setting value, which may be empty when the raw occurrence is malformed.

recognized.description: Whether the setting name is recognized by the WebVTT implementation.

valid.description: Whether the occurrence is both recognized and valid for its setting grammar.

document_format_data.title: Document native format data
document_format_data.description: Exactly one document-level native representation matching the document format.

subrip_document_format_data.title: SubRip document format data
subrip_document_format_data.description: Document native-data wrapper used when format is subrip.

webvtt_document_format_data.title: WebVTT document format data
webvtt_document_format_data.description: Document native-data wrapper used when format is webvtt.

webvtt.description: Native WebVTT document observations and retained non-cue blocks.

subrip_document_data.title: Native SubRip document data
subrip_document_data.description: Document-level native SubRip dialect identity and optional decoding observations.

dialect.description: Canonical native dialect identity for SubRip document data.

decoding_notes.description: Producer decoding observations, or null when no additional note is needed.

webvtt_document_data.title: Native WebVTT document data
webvtt_document_data.description: Retained WebVTT signature, header metadata, and ordered non-cue blocks.

signature.description: Required WebVTT signature token identifying the native document grammar.

signature_line_raw.description: Decoded complete WebVTT signature line, including an optional header description.

description.description: Text following WEBVTT on the signature line, or null when absent.

metadata_lines.description: Ordered decoded metadata lines between the signature and first native block.

blocks.description: Ordered retained non-cue WebVTT blocks interleaved with cues by source_order.

webvtt_block.title: Native WebVTT non-cue block
webvtt_block.description: A retained NOTE, STYLE, REGION, or unrecognized block in native source order.

type.description: Class of retained WebVTT non-cue block.

source_order.description: Zero-based position in the combined native cue and non-cue source sequence.

raw.description: Complete decoded block body joined with LF without replacing original source bytes.

raw_lines.description: Ordered physical block lines without embedded line terminators.

region.description: Parsed REGION data, present only when type is region.

webvtt_region_data.title: Native WebVTT region data
webvtt_region_data.description: Retained raw REGION settings, effective recognized values, and ordered occurrences.

settings_raw.description: Decoded REGION settings text following the native REGION marker.

settings.description: Effective recognized WebVTT REGION settings after occurrence processing.

setting_occurrences.description: Ordered raw REGION setting occurrences, including invalid and unrecognized settings.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.description: One deterministic observation about source interpretation, tolerance, support, or loss.

examples.message: A tolerated source variant was preserved.

severity.description: Diagnostic impact level used for deterministic reporting and stream policy.

message.description: Non-empty human-readable diagnostic explanation without sensitive source content.

source_order.description: Related native source-order position, or null for a document-level diagnostic.

cue_id.description: Related document-local cue identifier, or null when the diagnostic is not cue-specific.

stats.title: Document statistics
stats.description: Derived aggregate counts and timing facts for the validated Cue JSON document.

cue_count.description: Number of cues in the common model.

diagnostic_count.description: Total number of diagnostics in the ordered diagnostics collection.

warning_count.description: Number of diagnostics whose severity is warning.

error_count.description: Number of diagnostics whose severity is error.

has_word_level_timing.description: Whether any common-model token carries word-level timing.

media_span_milliseconds.description: Milliseconds from earliest cue start to latest cue end, or null when unavailable.

scripted_color.title: Native ABGR color
scripted_color.description: Independent native alpha, blue, green, and red byte components; SSA native color and AlphaLevel semantics remain separate.

scripted_value.title: Recognized native typed value
scripted_value.description: Exactly one optional recognized typed projection of an ordered native lexical field; its value must agree with the lexical owner.

string.description: Recognized native string without lexical normalization.

scripted_field.title: Ordered native field occurrence
scripted_field.description: One declaration-ordered lexical value, optionally accompanied by a checked typed value; duplicates and unknown fields are retained as occurrences.

field_name.description: Exact native declared field spelling and surrounding spaces.

raw_value.description: Editable exact lexical field owner; Start/End are preserved observations while common cue timing owns edits.

typed_value.description: Optional recognized projection that must agree with raw_value.

scripted_declaration_field.title: Ordered declaration field
scripted_declaration_field.description: Exact declaration spelling plus optional ASCII-normalized recognized identity; Actor is the explicit Name alias.

recognized_name.description: ASCII lowercase recognized identity after ASCII-space trimming and Name/Actor alias resolution.

scripted_section.title: Scripted section occurrence
scripted_section.description: An individually identified physical section header, including repeated and inert unknown sections.

section_id.description: Document-local identity of this section occurrence.

source_order.description: Position in the combined section-header and physical-record sequence.

name.description: Exact decoded section name excluding brackets.

raw_header.description: Optional original decoded header observation; omitted for constructed headers.

scripted_record.title: Scripted physical record
scripted_record.description: One ordered physical record with only its applicable content owner; raw_line is an optional capture observation for recognized structured records.

record_id.description: Document-local identity of the physical record.

source_order.description: Position in the combined section-header and record sequence.

kind.description: Closed structural record classification; retained malformed records require diagnostics and cannot render.

raw_line.description: Original decoded physical line without terminator, required for uninterpreted/attachment-data content, never replayed over structured edits.

fields.description: Ordered structured metadata values, owned only by metadata records.

declaration_fields.description: Ordered exact Format declaration fields, owned only by format_declaration records.

style_id.description: Style occurrence owning this style record.

event_id.description: Event occurrence owning this event record.

attachment_id.description: Attachment occurrence owning this attachment-header record.

scripted_style.title: Native style occurrence
scripted_style.description: An ordered native style with dialect-specific lexical values and occurrence references, never a deduplicated name map.

style_id.description: Identity of this individual style occurrence.

declaration_id.description: Applicable preceding declaration record; omitted only for constructed recognized styles without capture.

name.description: Exact native Name value, used for unambiguous occurrence-specific lookup.

valid.description: Whether retained style values are interpretable; invalid captured styles require diagnostics and cannot own dialogue.

fields.description: Complete declared native style field occurrences in native order.

scripted_span.title: Native Text span
scripted_span.description: One ordered half-open Unicode scalar span into event Text, retaining literal text, override/comment blocks, or drawing content.

start_scalar.description: Inclusive Unicode scalar offset into owning event Text.

end_scalar.description: Exclusive Unicode scalar offset into owning event Text.

raw.description: Exact owning Text substring for this span.

scripted_tag.title: Native override occurrence
scripted_tag.description: One ordered native tag occurrence retaining variant, parameters, lexeme and half-open scalar offsets into event Text.

name.description: Exact native tag identity including case-sensitive karaoke variants.

parameter.description: Complete native parameter lexeme, including retained nested transform syntax.

start_scalar.description: Inclusive offset of the tag backslash into event Text.

end_scalar.description: Exclusive offset of this tag occurrence.

raw.description: Exact native tag lexeme, including backslash.

scripted_karaoke.title: Native karaoke occurrence
scripted_karaoke.description: A native karaoke variant and checked duration observation; unsupported state is retained without fabricated timed tokens.

duration_centiseconds.description: Checked native duration observation; negative/unsupported values are retained with diagnostics.

supported.description: Whether the selected in-cue sequential token projection is valid.

scripted_event.title: Native scripted event
scripted_event.description: One native Dialogue, Comment or inert unsupported event occurrence; only Dialogue has a one-to-one common cue.

declaration_id.description: Applicable preceding declaration record, omitted only for constructed recognized events without capture.

event_type.description: Lowercase native event class; active Command/template content is prohibited.

cue_id.description: Common cue identity, present exactly for Dialogue events.

valid.description: Whether the native event is interpretable; malformed Dialogue is invalid input, while diagnosed malformed non-dialogue remains retained.

fields.description: Complete native event lexical field occurrences; final Text owns commas and escapes.

text.description: Exact editable native Text including overrides, drawings, commas, spaces and explicit escapes.

spans.description: Deterministically derived native Text span occurrences.

tags.description: Ordered native override occurrences, including duplicate and unsupported tags.

karaoke.description: Ordered native karaoke observations with supported/unsupported timing provenance.

scripted_attachment.title: Retained embedded attachment
scripted_attachment.description: A safe-named embedded font/graphic whose ordered encoded content is owned by a contiguous physical record range, never filesystem authority.

data_start_record_id.description: First encoded-data physical record in the contiguous range.

data_record_count.description: Number of contiguous attachment-data physical records in the same section.

attachment_type.description: Embedded native asset type; no loading, installation, extraction, or rasterization implied.

name.description: Portable embedded attachment name, never a path or URI.

scripted_projection.title: Native-derived common projection provenance
scripted_projection.description: Explicit event/field ownership, initial wrap state and drawing exclusion for deterministic common text/speaker/token projection.

origin.description: Native derivation origin, independent from captured source truth.

speaker_field_name.description: Exact Name/Actor field spelling, present only when a nonempty native speaker observation exists.

wrap_style.description: Document WrapStyle entering Text projection; explicit q tags may change subsequent soft-break state.

drawing_excluded.description: Whether retained drawing spans were excluded from readable common text.

scripted_cue_data.title: Scripted cue ownership
scripted_cue_data.description: References linking one common Dialogue cue to its native event/style and explicit projections; common timing owns edits while timestamp lexemes remain optional original observations.

start_timestamp_raw.description: Optional original native Start timestamp observation, independent from later common timing edits.

end_timestamp_raw.description: Optional original native End timestamp observation.

ass_document_data.title: ASS native document
ass_document_data.description: Complete ordered ASS native document with section/record ownership and retained structured/content observations.

sections.description: Ordered section-header occurrences, including repeated headers.

records.description: Ordered physical record occurrences; combined sections and records have a 65,536 ceiling.

styles.description: Ordered native style occurrences referenced by record identity.

events.description: Ordered native event occurrences referenced by record identity.

attachments.description: Ordered embedded attachment occurrences and contiguous encoded record ranges.

scripted_format_support.title: Scripted format capability observation
scripted_format_support.description: Exact ASS/SSA capability observations for the bounded stable native profile: schema_only recognition or complete experimental/stable native workflows. Source bytes remain authoritative; retained styles, drawings, transforms, attachments and unsupported karaoke do not promise pixel rendering, external resource loading or legacy codepage decoding.
